questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?  If I ____ the truth, I would have told you.
questions.why: 주절이 would have p.p.이므로 가정법 과거완료이다. if절은 had p.p.인 had known을 쓴다. knew는 가정법 과거의 형태이다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?  If he ____ up early, he wouldn't have missed the train.
questions.why: 주절이 wouldn't have missed이므로 if절은 had p.p.인 had gotten이다. 현재완료 has gotten은 가정법에 쓰지 않는다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?  If the weather ____ nice, we would have gone to the beach.
questions.why: 주절 would have gone에 맞춰 if절은 had been이 되어야 한다. were는 가정법 과거(현재 사실의 반대)에 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?  If Mina ____ her homework, she could have watched the movie.
questions.why: could have p.p.와 짝을 이루는 if절은 had p.p.이므로 had finished가 알맞다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?  If they ____ the map, they wouldn't have gotten lost.
questions.why: 가정법 과거완료의 if절은 had p.p.이다. brought는 단순 과거형이라 쓸 수 없다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?  If I ____ so much cake, I wouldn't have felt sick.
questions.why: 가정법 과거완료의 부정은 had not p.p.이므로 hadn't eaten이다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?  If the bus ____ late, we would have arrived on time.
questions.why: 주절이 would have arrived이므로 if절은 had not been, 즉 hadn't been이다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?  If you ____ me, I would have helped you.
questions.why: 가정법 과거완료이므로 if절에는 had p.p.인 had called를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?  If my sister ____ the window, the room wouldn't have been so cold.
questions.why: wouldn't have been과 짝을 이루는 if절은 had closed이다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?  If Jake ____ a coat, he wouldn't have caught a cold.
questions.why: 가정법 과거완료의 if절은 had p.p.이므로 had worn이다. wear의 과거분사는 worn이다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?  If I had had more time, I ____ the whole book.
questions.why: if절이 had p.p.이므로 주절은 would have p.p.인 would have read이다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?  If she had studied medicine, she ____ a doctor.
questions.why: 가정법 과거완료의 주절은 would have p.p.이므로 would have become이다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?  If we had known about the party, we ____ to it.
questions.why: if절이 had known이므로 주절은 would have come이다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?  If Dad had woken me up, I ____ late for school that morning.
questions.why: 과거에 지각한 사실의 반대를 말하므로 주절은 wouldn't have been이다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?  If the store had been open, I ____ some milk.
questions.why: if절이 had been이므로 주절은 조동사+have p.p.인 could have bought가 알맞다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?  If he had asked me, I ____ him the answer.
questions.why: 가정법 과거완료의 주절에는 조동사+have p.p.를 쓰므로 might have given이 알맞다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?  If the team had practiced more, they ____ the game.
questions.why: if절이 had practiced이므로 주절은 would have won이다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?  If I hadn't lost my key, I ____ into the house.
questions.why: 과거 사실의 반대를 나타내므로 주절은 could have gotten이다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?  If you had listened to me, you ____ the same mistake.
questions.why: 가정법 과거완료의 주절은 would(not) have p.p.이므로 wouldn't have made이다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?  If the movie had started on time, we ____ the ending.
questions.why: if절이 had started이므로 주절은 wouldn't have missed이다.

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?  If I <u>had</u> <u>saw</u> the sign, I <u>would</u> <u>have</u> <u>stopped</u>.
questions.why: had 뒤에는 과거분사가 와야 하므로 saw가 아니라 seen이다.

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?  If Ted <u>had</u> <u>drive</u> <u>more slowly</u>, he <u>would not</u> <u>have had</u> an accident.
questions.why: had 뒤에는 과거분사가 와야 하므로 drive가 아니라 driven이다.

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?  If we <u>have</u> <u>left</u> <u>earlier</u>, we <u>would</u> <u>have arrived</u> on time.
questions.why: 가정법 과거완료의 if절은 had p.p.이므로 have left가 아니라 had left이다.

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?  If I had known the answer, I <u>will</u> <u>have</u> <u>raised</u> my <u>hand</u> <u>then</u>.
questions.why: 가정법 과거완료의 주절에는 will이 아니라 would를 써서 would have raised로 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?  If Amy had taken the subway, she <u>would</u> <u>have</u> <u>arrive</u> <u>on</u> <u>time</u>.
questions.why: would have 뒤에는 과거분사가 와야 하므로 arrive가 아니라 arrived이다.

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?  If the boys <u>hadn't</u> <u>played</u> outside, they <u>wouldn't</u> <u>had</u> <u>caught</u> colds.
questions.why: 주절은 would have p.p.이므로 wouldn't had가 아니라 wouldn't have여야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?  If I <u>hadn't</u> <u>be</u> <u>sick</u>, I <u>would have</u> <u>joined</u> the trip.
questions.why: had 뒤에는 과거분사가 와야 하므로 be가 아니라 been이다.

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?  If Sujin <u>had had</u> a camera, she <u>would</u> <u>have</u> <u>take</u> <u>a picture</u>.
questions.why: would have 뒤에는 과거분사가 와야 하므로 take가 아니라 taken이다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
choices: If I had studied, I would have passed.
If I had studied, I would has passed.
If I had study, I would have passed.
If I have studied, I would have passed.
If I studied, I would have passed.
questions.why: 가정법 과거완료는 If+주어+had p.p., 주어+would have p.p. 형태이다. have studied, studied, had study, would has는 모두 형태가 틀렸다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: If he had run faster, he would have won.
If he has run faster, he would have won.
If he had run faster, he will have won.
If he run faster, he would have won.
If he had ran faster, he would have won.
questions.why: run의 과거분사는 run이므로 had run이 맞고, 주절은 would have won이다. ran, has run, will have won, run은 모두 틀린 형태이다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
choices: If she had call me, I would have answered.
If we had hurried, we might have caught the train.
If it had snowed, we would have made a snowman.
If I had been you, I would have said sorry.
If he had tried, he could have done it.
questions.why: had 뒤에는 과거분사가 와야 하므로 had call이 아니라 had called이다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
choices: If they had be quiet, we would have heard the bird.
If Mom had been home, she would have cooked dinner.
If I hadn't forgotten my ticket, I would have entered.
If you had asked, I would have shared my lunch.
If the sun had come out, the snow would have melted.
questions.why: had 뒤에는 과거분사가 와야 하므로 had be가 아니라 had been이다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 올바른 것은?
choices: If I hadn't lost my phone, I would have called you.
If I hadn't lose my phone, I would have called you.
If I haven't lost my phone, I would have called you.
If I hadn't lost my phone, I wouldn't called you.
If I didn't lose my phone, I would have called you.
questions.why: 가정법 과거완료의 부정 if절은 hadn't p.p.이고 주절은 would have p.p.이다. 나머지는 형태가 모두 어긋난다.

questions.stem: 다음 다섯 문장 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
choices: If the door had been locked, the cat wouldn't have run away.
If the door has been locked, the cat wouldn't have run away.
If the door had been locked, the cat wouldn't run away then.
If the door had been lock, the cat wouldn't have run away.
If the door had being locked, the cat wouldn't have run away.
questions.why: if절은 had been locked, 주절은 wouldn't have run away로 짝이 맞다. then은 과거를 가리키므로 wouldn't run away는 쓸 수 없다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
choices: He would have call me if he had had time.
They would have stayed if the rain had stopped.
I would have helped you if you had asked.
She could have won if she had trained harder.
We might have met if I had gone to the party.
questions.why: would have 뒤에는 과거분사가 와야 하므로 call이 아니라 called이다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 바르게 쓰인 것은?
choices: If I had woken up earlier, I would have caught the bus.
If I have woken up earlier, I would have caught the bus.
If I had woken up earlier, I would caught the bus.
If I had woke up earlier, I would have caught the bus.
If I had wake up earlier, I would have caught the bus.
questions.why: wake의 과거분사는 woken이므로 had woken up이 맞고, 주절은 would have caught이다.

questions.stem: 다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?  내가 그 소식을 들었더라면, 나는 너에게 전화했을 텐데.
choices: If I have heard the news, I would have called you.
If I had hear the news, I would have called you.
If I heard the news, I would call you.
If I had heard the news, I would call you.
If I had heard the news, I would have called you.
questions.why: 과거 사실의 반대이므로 If+had p.p., would have p.p. 형태인 3번이 알맞다.

questions.stem: 다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?  그가 더 조심했더라면, 그는 그 접시를 깨뜨리지 않았을 텐데.
choices: If he had been more careful, he wouldn't have broken the dish.
If he had been more careful, he wouldn't break the dish.
If he has been more careful, he wouldn't have broken the dish.
If he had be more careful, he wouldn't have broken the dish.
If he was more careful, he wouldn't break the dish.
questions.why: 가정법 과거완료이므로 had been과 wouldn't have broken이 짝을 이루어야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?  우리가 지도를 봤더라면, 우리는 길을 잃지 않았을 텐데.
choices: If we have looked at the map, we wouldn't have gotten lost.
If we look at the map, we won't get lost.
If we looked at the map, we wouldn't get lost.
If we had looked at the map, we wouldn't get lost.
If we had looked at the map, we wouldn't have gotten lost.
questions.why: 과거에 지도를 보지 않아 길을 잃은 사실의 반대이므로 had looked와 wouldn't have gotten이 짝을 이룬다.

questions.stem: 다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?  네가 나를 도와주었더라면, 나는 그 일을 끝낼 수 있었을 텐데.
choices: If you had helped me, I could have finished the work.
If you have helped me, I could have finished the work.
If you had help me, I could have finished the work.
If you helped me, I could finish the work.
If you had helped me, I could finish the work.
questions.why: 가정법 과거완료의 주절에 could가 쓰이면 could have p.p.가 된다.

questions.stem: 다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?  날씨가 좋았더라면, 우리는 소풍을 갔을 텐데.
choices: If the weather had been good, we would go on a picnic.
If the weather has been good, we would have gone on a picnic.
If the weather is good, we will go on a picnic.
If the weather were good, we would go on a picnic.
If the weather had been good, we would have gone on a picnic.
questions.why: 과거의 날씨에 대한 반대 가정이므로 had been과 would have gone이 짝을 이룬다.

questions.stem: 다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?  내가 그녀의 주소를 알았더라면, 나는 카드를 보냈을 텐데.
choices: If I had known her address, I would have sent a card.
If I have known her address, I would have sent a card.
If I knew her address, I would send a card.
If I had known her address, I would send a card.
If I had knew her address, I would have sent a card.
questions.why: know의 과거분사는 known이므로 had known이 맞고, 주절은 would have sent이다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?  • If I ____ studied, I would have passed the test.  • If she ____ been there, she would have seen it.
questions.why: 두 문장 모두 가정법 과거완료의 if절이므로 had p.p. 형태의 had가 공통으로 들어간다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?  • If Amy had asked me, I ____ have lent her my bike.  • If it hadn't rained, they ____ have gone camping.
questions.why: 가정법 과거완료의 주절은 would have p.p.이므로 would가 공통으로 들어간다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 알맞게 짝지어진 것은?  If Kevin ____ earlier, he ____ the first train. (케빈이 더 일찍 일어났더라면 첫 기차를 탔을 텐데.)
choices: had gotten up - would have taken
has gotten up - would have taken
questions.why: 가정법 과거완료는 If+had p.p., would have p.p.이므로 had gotten up과 would have taken이 짝을 이룬다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 알맞게 짝지어진 것은?  If the class ____ boring, the students ____ asleep. (수업이 지루하지 않았더라면 학생들은 잠들지 않았을 텐데.)
questions.why: 과거 사실의 반대이므로 hadn't been과 wouldn't have fallen이 짝을 이룬다.

questions.stem: 다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?  A: Why didn't you come to my birthday party?  B: I'm sorry. If I ____ about it, I would have come.
questions.why: 파티를 몰라서 못 온 과거 사실의 반대를 말하므로 if절은 had known이다.

questions.stem: 다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?  A: I failed the math test again.  B: If you ____ my advice, you wouldn't have failed it.
questions.why: 주절이 wouldn't have failed이므로 if절은 had taken이다.

questions.stem: 괄호 안의 동사를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 빈칸에 쓰시오. (두 단어)  If I ____ (be) taller, I would have joined the basketball team.
questions.why: 주절이 would have joined이므로 if절은 had p.p.인 had been이다.

questions.stem: 괄호 안의 동사를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 빈칸에 쓰시오. (두 단어)  If she ____ (bring) her camera, she would have taken photos.
questions.why: 가정법 과거완료의 if절은 had p.p.이므로 had brought이다.

questions.stem: 괄호 안의 동사를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 빈칸에 쓰시오. (would를 포함하여 세 단어)  If we had left home earlier, we ____ (catch) the bus.
questions.why: if절이 had left이므로 주절은 would have p.p.인 would have caught이다.

questions.stem: 괄호 안의 동사를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 빈칸에 쓰시오. (would를 포함하여 세 단어)  If Peter had studied, he ____ (pass) the exam.
questions.why: 가정법 과거완료의 주절은 would have p.p.이다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰시오.  If I <u>have known</u> your birthday, I would have bought a gift.
questions.why: 주절이 would have bought이므로 if절은 have known이 아니라 had known이어야 한다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰시오.  If it hadn't rained, we <u>would went</u> to the park.
questions.why: 가정법 과거완료의 주절은 would have p.p.이므로 would have gone이다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰시오.  If Jenny had had time, she <u>would visited</u> her grandmother.
questions.why: 주절은 would+have+과거분사 형태여야 한다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰시오.  If the boys <u>had ran</u> faster, they would have won the race.
questions.why: run의 과거분사는 run이므로 had ran이 아니라 had run이다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰시오.  If you had asked me, I <u>would have help</u> you.
questions.why: have 뒤에는 과거분사가 와야 하므로 help가 아니라 helped이다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰시오.  If he <u>had be</u> careful, he wouldn't have fallen.
questions.why: had 뒤에는 과거분사가 와야 하므로 be가 아니라 been이다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 가정법 과거완료 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오. (If로 시작하고 would를 쓸 것)  I didn't have money, so I didn't buy the book.
questions.answer: If I had had money, I would have bought the book.
questions.why: 돈이 없어서 사지 못한 과거 사실의 반대이므로 if절은 had had, 주절은 would have bought이다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 가정법 과거완료 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오. (If로 시작하고 would를 쓸 것)  She didn't take the medicine, so she didn't get better.
questions.answer: If she had taken the medicine, she would have gotten better.
alt: If she had taken the medicine, she would have got better.
questions.why: 약을 먹지 않아 낫지 않은 사실의 반대이므로 had taken과 would have gotten이 짝을 이룬다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 가정법 과거완료 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오. (If로 시작하고 would를 쓸 것)  It rained, so we didn't go hiking.
questions.answer: If it hadn't rained, we would have gone hiking.
alt: If it had not rained, we would have gone hiking.
questions.why: 비가 온 사실의 반대이므로 if절은 hadn't rained, 주절은 would have gone이다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 가정법 과거완료 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오. (If로 시작하고 would를 쓸 것)  I was busy, so I didn't call you.

questions.stem: 괄호 안의 말을 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 빈칸에 쓰시오.  If Dan ____ (not, eat) so fast, he wouldn't have had a stomachache.

questions.stem: 괄호 안의 말을 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 빈칸에 쓰시오.  If we ____ (not, forget) the tickets, we would have entered the museum.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?  ㄱ. If the storm had passed, the ferry would have departed.  ㄴ. If Jane had not been late, the meeting would have start on time.  ㄷ. questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B), (C)의 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?  Sujin failed the audition last month. If she ____ (A) her voice more often, she ____ (B) a better performance. She still regrets it, and she says that if she ____ (C) harder then, she would be on stage now.

questions.why: 과거의 조건과 현재의 결과를 잇는 혼합 가정법이므로 if절은 had saved이다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?  Amy moved to a small village three years ago. She often says, "If I <u>had stayed</u> in the city, my life <u>would be</u> much busier now. questions.stem: 다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?  네가 그 이메일을 확인했더라면, 너는 그 회의를 놓치지 않았을 텐데.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?  ㄱ. If the ice hadn't melted, the drink would still be cold.  ㄴ. If Ryan had been honest, no one would have doubted him.  ㄷ. questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 알맞은 한 단어를 쓰시오.  If the rumor ____ been true, the company would have collapsed.
questions.why: 가정법 과거완료의 if절은 had+과거분사이다.

questions.stem: 다음 두 문장을 If를 사용하여 한 문장으로 쓰시오. (혼합 가정법, could를 쓸 것)  Emma didn't learn to drive. She can't go on a road trip with us now.
questions.answer: If Emma had learned to drive, she could go on a road trip with us now.
questions.why: 과거의 조건은 had p.p., 현재의 결과는 could+동사원형으로 쓰는 혼합 가정법이다.

questions.stem: 다음 두 문장을 If를 사용하여 한 문장으로 쓰시오. (가정법 과거완료, would를 쓸 것)  The audience didn't applaud. The singer didn't sing another song.
questions.answer: If the audience had applauded, the singer would have sung another song.
questions.why: 실제 사실이 모두 부정이므로 가정법에서는 긍정으로 바꾸어 had applauded와 would have sung을 쓴다.
